data.content_ref: inline:Attach a monotonically increasing timestamp to every warrant and define attack success as depending on whether the attacker's warrant is newer than the defender's support chain's maximum timestamp; the grounded extension is the least fixed point of a monotone operator over timestamped labels. This allows strengthening by adding newer warrants without relabeling older decisions. Criticizable because it breaks reinstatement as a derived property, since a node's status can change solely due to timestamp comparisons, and it may not be polynomial unless timestamps are bounded by a polynomial of graph size.
